profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aristocrat
profile.summary: A new member of the workforce with a strong drive to get moving. My educational background is in Comp Sci with a strong focus on tooling and ethical use.  My top three soft skills are Communication, Critical Thinking , and Professional Conduct. My hobbies and interests include Cooking, Visual Art, Game Development, Gardening, Photography ,Music ,Health & Fitness , and Storytelling. When in a team I'm quick to learn about my team members as to better support them as we tackle a project. When working alone I'm quick to find an efficient work flow and adapt to changes that come my way.
